notes.title: The Break-In 1.0 Launch Update
notes.content:
After nearly two years of Early Access, the Break-In is finally launching for real. It's been a long road, and I want to thank everyone who has played the game during the Early Access period, especially those of you who have been making cool suggestions and reporting bugs in the discord. You guys made this game possible! I have prepared a big update to celebrate the launch, and I hope you'll enjoy all of the new content. Here's a summary of what's been added.

[h2]Playground Level[/h2]
Everyone likes a playground, so I made one for you. Please enjoy the monkey bars and slide, and don't investigate the map too much. There are [b]no secrets[/b] hiding within, and [b]definitely no cool items[/b] from old playtests to be found. (If you hear any rustling, large mechanical doors opening, or explosions coming from undergound, please [b]ignore[/b].)

[h2]Perks and Classes[/h2]
I have also added the long-awaited perks and classes system. Head over to the "class" room in the lobby to select your class, and unlock perks by doing missions. The perks are very powerful, and synergise well together, so gather a mixed team and get stealing! The classes are as follows:

[h3]Infiltrator - Sneaky and fast. [/h3]
The Infiltrator is who you send in first. They'll open up the level for the rest of the team, jumping up to the roof, climbing the side of buildings like spiderman, and remaining undetected the whole time.

[h3]Strongman - Strong and a Fighter.[/h3]
The Strongman can carry heavy items with ease, even throwing them across the map. They should be sent to steal the heavy stuff. The cars, the fridge, maybe the people. The Strongman can also learn secret martial arts techniques that will allow them to KO even guards and police with their fists.

[h3]Mastermind - Intelligent and prepared.[/h3]
The Mastermind has access to special info about the mission, like where the best loot is and how many residents and guards are present. They can also learn to hack, disabling lights, cameras, and lasers, and even opening the vault with just their laptop.

[h2]Escaping the Police Van[/h2]
Previously, getting Busted was a life sentence. The police van was frustratingly inescapable, and many burglar friends were sadly left behind sitting in it. Now, thanks to advances
in burglar technology, it's possible to lockpick your friends out of the van, freeing them once again.

[h2]New Items[/h2]
For the launch update, I decided to re-think the items I wanted to add to the game. Initially, I planned to add things like drones and selfie sticks, but I realised that these are kind of gimmicky and not very useful in an actual mission. Instead, I have added some item "upgrades" to your existing favourites. 

The swaggier bag is an upgraded swag bag, much bigger and able to fit larger items, but it can't be put on a toolbelt. The battering ram is an upgraded hammer, and has much higher breaking power but is larger and harder to sneak in. I have also upgraded the rope launcher to add the zipline feature from way back in the first demo of the game, because it's cool. The rope launcher has also been re-coded to make it work better. I added the shrink ray too, but I forgot where I left it.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
There have been a number of bug fixes, including preventing wall-stuckness in VR, making vents less broken in non VR, server stability, and ragdoll containment. I continue to monitor the discord channel for bug reports, so if you see issues, please post about them there!

notes.title: Big Update 3 - Vaults and Vents and Other Stuff
notes.content:
Update 3 is now live! It includes a new level, 3 new gear items, 2 new getaways, new entry methods, and new security measures for you to avoid. As always, let me know what you think of the update in the comments, and tell me if you find any bugs!


[b]Bank Level[/b]
People have been requesting a bank level since the game released in Early Access, and it's finally here with update 3. The main attraction is the large vault in the back, which has a double layer security system. The first pre-vault room is accessible through regular-style doors, although they're heavy barred doors which will be difficult to break down. The main vault area is behind a huge, unbreakable vault door which must be opened through a series of locks throughout the level. It's a tough task, but you'll be rewarded with gold, diamonds, cash, and priceless artworks if you can get inside.


[b]Vaults[/b]
The bank vault is not the only one in the game. A hidden vault has also been added to the mansion level, with a secret stash of valuable items inside. To open a vault, you'll need to open 3 randomised locks scattered around the level. They can be either simple buttons, keycard scanners, or retina scanners. On levels with a vault, there will be a vault room which will show you your progress towards opening it. Security lasers may also be present, which will trigger an alarm and call the cops if you touch them.


[b]Vents and Chimneys[/b]
Sick of going through the front door like a loser? Now you can sneak in through the vent system, or climb down the chimney like a burglary santa claus. These provide cool new ways to get in and out, or to hide from NPCs.


[b]New Gear[/b]
An old favourite, the rope launcher, is returning to the game. It is now purchaseable again, and can be used to create climbable lines to easily access rooftops. It has the added functionality of breaking anything you shoot with it, from doors to people! There is also a new ball and chain item, which can be used to slow down residents to make them easier to manage and/or steal. The final new item is the attachable wheel, which can be stuck to heavy stealables to allow you to easily wheel them away to your getaway.


[b]New Getaways[/b]
To bridge the gap between the pickup truck and Dave's van, a new purchaseable ambulance getaway vehicle has been added. It's a little more spacious than the pickup, and has a cool siren for when you leave the mission. There is also a new secret getaway vehicle which can be unlocked!


[b]Breakers[/b]
To help you deal with all the new security measures, each level now contains at least one breaker switch, which will disable lights, cameras, and lasers in an area. Darkness has also been buffed, so killing the lights and hiding in the shadows is now a valid option. Just be careful on larger levels, as some breakers might be alarmed! Check the intel board in your getaway vehicle to see which one to avoid.


Thank you to everyone who continues to play and enjoy the game! I hope this update gives you fresh new challenges and fun times. I'll be working on bugfixes over the next few weeks, before starting work on the next update.

notes.title: New Year Patch
notes.content:
A new patch has been released to address some of the annoying bugs and balance issues highlighted by players over the Christmas period.

Many new players found it difficult to progress, especially without stealing big ticket items like cars and residents. To reduce the grind, driver cuts have been reduced, with additional reductions when playing in multiplayer. There is also now a significantly increased bonus for stealing lots of items (10+), which increases exponentially and is capped at $35k per mission.

I will be working on more bugfixes over the coming weeks, before starting work on Update 3. If you have any suggestions for the game, I’m active in the discord server linked below so post them there!

For the full change log, see below:
[list]
[*] Reduced getaway driver cuts for all vehicles
[*] Further reduced cuts when in multiplayer based on number of players
[*] Renamed getaway danger fee to police called fee
[*] Increased bonus for stealing lots of items and made it exponential to reward players who like to steal many low value items
[*] Made unstealable stealables not appear as steal goals anymore (let me know if you find any that are still unstealable)
[*] Made players who are kicked from your lobby unable to return
[*] Collision fixes in [i]mansion[/i] map and police van
[*] Lighting fixes in house and mall levels

[/list]

notes.title: Christmas Event - Deliver Presents, Earn Prizes!
notes.content:
The Christmas update is now live! For the next month, you’ll be able to complete special missions to deliver presents to unsuspecting residents. As you complete more missions, you’ll unlock limited edition Santa cosmetics, as well as a brand new sleigh getaway vehicle!

The new mission type can appear on any mission (aside from the tutorial) and will require you to deliver a number of presents to the christmas tree located in the level. Santa would probably prefer if you didn’t bash the residents with a hammer, but he’s not watching.

We’ll also be holding discord challenges to celebrate the holiday season, and give out some Expert Burglar roles, so stay tuned to hear the details soon!

Merry Christmas, Happy New Year, and I look forward to working on the next big updates to the game for 2024!

notes.title: Mansion Map - Content Update 2
notes.content:
A new update has been released! Here’s an overview of what was added. There will be another update coming very soon with Christmas content, so stay tuned!

[b]Mansion Level[/b]
A brand new level which can spawn rarely from Dave and his mates. Break in to this huge private mansion, and steal everything from treasure chests to priceless artworks. Lots of new stealables have been added, as well as new entry ways!

[b]Tutorial Level[/b]
Need to sharpen your burglary skills? Head over to the abandoned house level for a tutorial. It can be found under its own intel team in the intel menu.

[b]VR Grabbing improvements[/b]
Grabbing has been made more precise in VR, and a laser guide will now appear when you’re trying to grab stuff so you can see what you’re grabbing. Object highlighting now appears in Quest as well as PCVR. These changes should make the toolbelt much easier to use!

[b]VR Climbing Axes Upgrade[/b]
Climbing axes have also had a revamp to make them much less finicky. They will now stay stuck in the wall until you press the trigger button to release them.

[b]New Mission Difficulty System[/b]
The old 3-factor system has been replaced with a simpler star based system. A 5 star level will be difficult, but give much greater goal rewards and be more likely to spawn top-tier loot. Cameras will now also take the difficulty rating into account.

[b]Fixes and Minor Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Made occupied toolbelt slot icon pop ups more sensitive for easier seated play
[*] Fixed detaching things in non VR in multiplayer sometimes causing your player model to fling across the map and break stuff
[*] Fixed some casino door locks being inaccessible in nonVR
[*] Reduced getaway driver cut for secret getaways
[/list]

notes.title: Boats 'n' Clothes update
notes.content:
The first content update for the Break-In will be going live on [b]25th September[/b]! I’m aiming to release the Quest app lab version on the same day, if it is approved in time. I will also be running a [b]special dev stream[/b] this [b]Saturday [/b]where viewers can [b]request new cosmetic items[/b], so check the discord events tab for updates.

[u]Update Changes[/u]
The main overhauls are the mission selection system, which will require you to upgrade your intel team before being able to play harder levels, and the cosmetics system, which is revamped to feature male and female characters, and additional items for you to spend your (in-game) earnings on. These changes should help with the progression of the game.

Other additions include the new container ship level, which features over 20 randomised cargo containers to steal from, as well as engine rooms and stealable ship parts. New gear items like the [strike]attachable wheels[/strike] (had to disable the wheels due to a bug, but I'll try to get these working in a patch soon), price scanner, and lockpick have also been added, along with new getaways like the flatbed truck, and more secret getaways.

The door locking system has also been overhauled, with a keyhole now appearing on locked doors which must be opened with the correct kind of key. Keycard readers are now properly implemented and can appear on any door, depending on the level and its access rating. Retina scanners have also been added, which require an eye-scan from a resident or guard.

Additionally, the “steal item” mission goal has been split into two possible goals, one targeting small items and one targeting large items. This will give players who go for large items a bigger reward.

On top of this, there are a number of performance improvements which have been made to support the Quest port. These should increase PC performance substantially as well. I’m also aiming to add more sounds and potentially lobby music in time for the update.

I've also added some more sounds here and there, such as AI footsteps, gear interaction, and lobby music. More sound improvements will be coming soon.

notes.title: 5th August Patch - tormented by lampshades
notes.content:
There have been a shocking number of bugs regarding lampshades, this patch should fix the most notable one. I have a couple reports of people unable to take them off in VR still, despite being able to grab them. I haven't managed to recreate this for myself yet, so if you have seen this bug let me know any more details you can think of.

Most of the important issues remaining will require larger patches, which I'll be working on alongside new content over the coming weeks. This includes issues with AI pathfinding and detection, physics bugs, and climbing bugs. Let me know if there are any other big things that you think need fixing.

[list]
[*] Made VR toolbelt icons appear sooner when looking down so it’s easier to see them
[*] Fixed broken state when climbing in nonVR causing players to be stuck in climb mode
[*] Fixed head wearables getting grabbed / put into the inventory of all nonVR players when removed by one player
[*] Split getaway danger fee into two stages, so you are charged a smaller fee if the police have been called but have not arrived yet
[*] Added offset option to VR toolbelt to move it forwards 
[*] Fixed occlusion in mechanic’s level causing shop to appear empty from outside
[*] Map collision fixes in casino
[/list]

notes.title: Patch - Non VR quality of life and bugfixes
notes.content:
A bunch of improvements to make non VR easier and less confusing, especially with climbing axes, carrying stuff and losing gear. More improvements planned later

[list]
[*] Fixed non-hosts not getting access to increased gear slots from host’s upgraded getaway vehicles
[*] Fixed possible bug when ending climb and dropping climbing axe at the same time could cause a broken player state
[*] Added protection against getting stuck in the shelves in cargo truck and dave’s van getaways
[*] Added protection for objects getting stuck in ungrabbable state in nonVR
[*] Fixed attachables sometimes instantly re-attaching when detaching them in non VR, causing them to seem to disappear
[*] Made carried tools go to toolbelt if there are slots when grabbing a two-handed object
[*] Made head wearables go to toolbelt if there are slots if you are holding things in both hands while removing
[*] Made head wearables get grabbed when removing instead of falling to the floor
[*] Fixed climbing axe dropping out of your hand when stopping climbing in nonVR
[/list]

Patch has now been re-uploaded with fixes to the void bug and NPC navigation issues.

notes.title: July 25th Patch - Getting through them
notes.content:
Last patch only fixed the head wearables for singleplayer, whoops. I will start work on new content tomorrow, tune into the twitch development stream to find out about the new upcoming level 👀

[list]
[*] Fixed broken item components (e.g. toilet seat and lid) being broken and behaving strangely when grabbed
[*] Added options button to reset player data
[*] Fixed AI being unable to leave cargo truck when inside
[*] Fixed residents/guards sometimes spawning in getaway vehicle if previously stolen
[*] Made save file system more robust, so the game should auto-recover from corrupt save files now instead of just not saving progress anymore
[*] Fixed head wearables in multiplayer
[/list]

notes.title: Day 7 Mini Patch
notes.content:
Just a couple small fixes. I am taking a couple days off now, next week I'll start working on new content as well as continuing to fix bugs. Patches will be coming 1-2 per week so I have time to work on new stuff

[list]
[*] Fixed not being able to remove head items
[*] Fixed bug where post-tasing invulnerability was not being applied properly (spawn kill protection)
[/list]

If you've tried out the new VR toolbelt system, let me know what you think in the comments. And if there are any more super annoying bugs you're still seeing, post those too.

notes.title: Day 6 Path - Revenge of the Toolbelt
notes.content:
In this patch I've revamped the toolbelt for VR players. Now, items on the toolbelt are not grabbable. Instead, the toolbelt icon itself is grabbable, and when you grab it it will automatically make you grab the item instead. This means that the grab positions are always the same regardless of the item on the belt, and should make it easier to know what you're grabbing. It is also now only possible to grab toolbelt items when you're looking down at your toolbelt, which should stop any accidental un-toolbelting.

This change is quite experimental so let me know what you think. If you have any bugs with it, comment here or post in the discord.

I believe the slow hands glitch is now fixed too, but it is quite intermittent for me so hard to confirm.

[list]
[*] Revamped VR toolbelt
[*] Fixed game-breaking smoke detector capitalization issue
[*] Fixed different slow hands bug
[*] Re-enabled raycast tasing to prevent tasing through walls and getaways
[*] Increased throw strength for VR players
[*] Fixed being able to sprint while crouching in VR
[*] Fixed RV not showing properly in lobby
[/list]

notes.title: Day 5 Patch 2 - Have your stretchy hands you animals
notes.content:
Hand teleporting is now split, so they will teleport after a short distance if you're not holding anything, and a longer distance if you are. This should stop the annoyance with hands falling off heavy stuff as you drag it. Eventually I want to add legit ways of moving heavy stuff, like winches and super strength perks, but for now you can use your stretchy hand powers instead.

Also note - you can still get your move speed like it was before, just enable fast move in settings. I wanted the default to be slower because people get motion sick

[list]
[*] Decreased sounds for glass smashing, airbags, and firecrackers
[*] Added auto-exposure to spectator camera for brighter footage in dark areas
[*] Made top of cargo truck doorway climbable for easier roof access
[*] Made light switches a little stickier and easier to flick in VR
[*] Moved getaway button on RV closer to door
[*] Fixed broken highlighting on ladders and other strange objects in VR
[*] Reduced VR move speed to combat motion sickness - added “fast move” option in menu to set it back to how it was before
[*] Made movement slower while crouched in VR to match nonVR
[*] Thickened cargo truck walls slightly to reduce collision bugs
[*] Split hand teleport distance so that hands teleport much quicker when you are not grabbing anything. Reverted distance when holding something back to previous value
[*] Made bob’s hardware less enticing
[/list]

notes.content:
The fifth playtest is now over! Thank you to everyone who took part, I hope you enjoyed burgling the new mall level and scaling walls with climbing axes!

As always, a huge amount of screenshots and videos were sent in as challenge submissions, through the official game discord. The winners of fresh new Expert Burglar roles have been announced there, so [url=https://discord.gg/6VBXa6Ea5Y]head on over[/url] to see who won each category!

I've also picked out a few of my own personal favourite screenshots for this test specially for this post

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245831/47a486e05d64982e5763f942909e324c6c1b566b.png[/img]
This screenshot from PigCollector shows the world's first dedicated burglar-band. Great composition and angle, looks like a real band shot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245831/bcf3998d64e38ab095ae5b22c991f9962a7c4c84.png[/img]
And from the pengwins team of PorkysRAGE, Eh I'll Buff Out, No_Warudo, and Gingerston, we have this huge tower of stolen vehicles. A very impressive stack, and the largest tower constructed for the Tallest Tower challenge! The most prolific burglary squad have outdone themselves once again

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245831/8b93ebd31e6944197fd7ed154429a1f00791ce2c.png[/img]
I loved this haul shot from <--- You Rn, with arcade machines and signs stacked on the roof, and an incredibly delighted burglar expressing their pure joy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245831/f26a8dc2429ee0df91f469e6e9a3e5418d62af91.png[/img]
And here we see the opposite emotion, in an upside-down-car shot from Untitled Discord User. I'm assuming the pictured burglar is just exhausted from a tricky haul, and not in the middle of an existential crisis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245831/329c87c951f564b1190a40b0111c1b7117819334.png[/img]
And finally, we have this very clean and tidy looking van from Sahne. Most burglars just throw their stolen goods in the back without much of a care, so it's refreshing to see all of these pilfered electronics stacked neatly on the shelves. And they stole a piano to boot!


Thanks again to everyone who sent in screenshots! There were so many more great ones which I couldn't highlight here, so [url=https://discord.gg/6VBXa6Ea5Y]check out the discord [/url]to see them all. The server recently hit the huge 10,000 member milestone, so maybe you'll find yourself a burglary squad for the next playtest 👀

Remember to wishlist the game, it helps out a lot with discovery on Steam!

notes.title: Fourth playtest over, and challenge winners!
notes.content:
The fourth public playtest has come to an end, after four days of burgling, bungling, breaking, and of course entering. Thank you to everyone who took part this time around!

It was the biggest playtest yet, with nearly 7,000 people, and an incredible amount of screenshots and videos. Like last time, discord roles were up for grabs in a series of challenges, so head over to the [url=https://discord.gg/6VBXa6Ea5Y]discord server[/url] to see who won them.

Here are a selection of my personal favourite screenshots from this test!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245831/ccfff01a479a92b569b7583f768d8bce6722f35f.png[/img]
I love the composition in this one, giving me real "Ah shit, here we go again" meme vibes. A real piece of art, well done to FlexTL, Philiking, Arian, and Oddity for capturing this one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245831/22edbaf8f94c3f03d467e7252e8b140e7ba5c268.png[/img]
An impressively full van, complete with a small burglar squirrelled away in amongst the stolen garden items. I very much enjoy the way his head pokes out from behind the fountain. Thank you to DingBoy_VR for this submission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245831/164d40287e1bf6ee07dea05f963cb157bcaca859.png[/img]
Lampshades are the ultimate show of dominance. By remaining perfectly still, and projecting the perfect kind of energy, you can convince a resident that you are in fact [b]lamp[/b]. TGP captures this excellently in his screenshot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245831/c7ee76522297f5130d4618059d30560a94e0acaa.png[/img]
Living up to their well-earned reputation once again, the Pengwins burglary crew hosted the ultimate roof party this playtest. Complete with hot-tub, barbecue, and of course a car. Gingerston, Porky, Jayce, and Eh I'll Buff Out hosted this especially well-put-together party.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245831/256573969ff0dc15b35b82a4461685a78dc5967e.png[/img]
And finally, from rydaguy we have this fantastic shot of a recently stolen car. I love the way they are showing off their haul; stealing a car is now a well-known rite of passage among the Break-In playtesters, and you can see the pride in these budding burglars as they demonstrate their skill.


Which is your favourite screenshot? Let me know down below 👀

Thanks again to all the playtesters for making this the biggest and best test so far! Be sure to [url=https://discord.gg/6VBXa6Ea5Y]join the discord[/url] if you haven't already, it has exploded up to over 7000 members recently, so you'll definitely be able to find a team for the next test!

Remember to wishlist the game, and follow along so you don't miss the next playtest

notes.title: Residents, Police, and Stun Guns, Oh My
notes.content:
[h2]Residents[/h2]
Development progress is coming along great on The Break-In, and some of the most-requested features have now been added. Meet our first resident.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Kcn5rhxnUbdjKDYTYC/giphy.gif[/img]

Try not to alert the residents. They tend to get scared easily when they find someone creeping around in their house, and they won't hesitate to call the police if they get away.

[h2]The Cops[/h2]
So you went and got yourself noticed. Couldn't quite get that 45" TV out the window in time, and some poor homeowner walked in on you trying to pilfer their favourite flat-screen? Worry not, the mission isn't over yet. Just don't let them get away.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Yk5Ml0PPkE9mFtRaDW/giphy.gif[/img]

So they went and got away. You should train that throwing arm a little sometime. Worry not, the police might be on their way, but you can probably get a few extra things to the van before they get here. Just try to be gone before they do.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/uYZQLJBiL5cMv4FJ7p/giphy.gif[/img]

You got greedy, didn't you? It's going to be much harder to steal stuff with all these cops milling around. You really don't want to get hit by that stun gun, either. Bail isn't cheap.
